import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    for p_str, k_str in zip(it, it):
        p = int(p_str)
        k = int(k_str)
        if k == 0:
            res = pow(p, p - 1, MOD)
        elif k == 1:
            res = pow(p, p, MOD)
        else:
            x = 1
            steps = 0
            while True:
                x = (x * k) % p
                steps += 1
                if x == 1:
                    break
            res = pow(p, (p - 1) // steps, MOD)
        print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
